title: Happy panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e8eef7'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#3b3f5c' transform='rotate(-20 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#3b3f5c' transform='rotate(20 74 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='90' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#3b3f5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='90' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#3b3f5c'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='26' fill='#e8eef7'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='22' r='9' fill='#3b3f5c'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='22' r='9' fill='#3b3f5c'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#5b5f80'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='22' r='4.5' fill='#5b5f80'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='40' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#3b3f5c' transform='rotate(-15 39 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='40' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#3b3f5c' transform='rotate(15 61 40)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='39' r='4' fill='#a8d8ff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='39' r='4' fill='#a8d8ff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4.5' ry='3.2' fill='#5b5f80'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 55 Q50 61 56 55' stroke='#5b5f80' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ff9ec4'/>
</svg>
